title: The Blue Note date with Fats Navarro
summary: 'Double Talk', 'The Skunk' and 'Boperation' for Alfred Lion with Klook, Milt Jackson, Curly Russell and Ernie Henry.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Yeah, well, with Fats, I had come back here from California... Right after I came back, then me and Fats decided we'd probably get together and do this date for Alfred Lion. Because I didn't know him, but Fats did, you know. So got together and we did "Double Talk" and "The Skunk" and "Boperation." And it was a beautiful date. We
had a ball. It was really nice, with Klook on drums...

Milt Jackson on piano. Curley Russell on bass, I think -- I'm pretty sure it was. And Fats and I and Ernie Henry. It came out pretty good. The two trumpets was the main issue there anyway. Which I'm grateful that it came out that good.
